leads.name: IDEAL 3
leads.drill: A composite of grab samples of the veinlets (1 to 3 centimetres wide) assayed 9.87 grams per tonne gold, 24.6 grams per tonne silver, 0.05 per cent copper, 0.8 per cent lead, 1.2 per cent zinc and 0.4 per cent arsenic (Assessment Report 16412). A sample (Sample 49A) assayed 0.42 per cent copper and 2.43 per cent zinc (Assessment Report 16412). In 1987, they had outlined  approximately 88 859 tonnes drill-indicated at 4.44 grams per tonne gold and 20.9 grams per tonne silver in the Lakeview-West grid and Domineer zones. They drilled one intersection of 15.9 metres of 5.56 grams per tonne gold plus 2.7 metres of 2.5 grams per tonne gold and 3 metres of 3.44 grams per tonne gold (Assessment Report 22975).

leads.name: GRANISLE
leads.drill: In 1969, a diamond drill program of 10,000 meters in 50 holes increased reserves to 81 million tonnes proven of 0.43 per cent copper.
leads.operators: Noranda Minerals Inc. (Babine Div.), Xstrata Canada Corporation, Galambos

leads.name: DRAGON
leads.drill: A grab sample from a mineralized section of the vein assayed 13.36 per cent copper and 15 grams per tonne silver (Minister of Mines Annual Report 1924).
leads.operators: Eagle Plains Resources Ltd., Dragoon Resources Ltd., Strata GeoData Services Ltd.

leads.name: VICTORIA (L.2464)
leads.drill: A selected sample of arsenopyrite assayed 4.5 grams per tonne gold and 8.6 grams per tonne silver (Minister of Mines Annual Report 1936, page D12). 2 adit, across 66 centimetres of quartz, assayed 9.6 grams per tonne gold and 10 grams per tonne silver (Minister of Mines Annual Report 1936, page D12).
leads.operators: Mascot Gold Mines Ltd., Brohm Res.

leads.name: JOHN BULL
leads.drill: The best assays from several samples were 52 per cent zinc, 150.83 grams per tonne silver, 0.8 per cent copper, 2.0 per cent lead and 23.99 grams per tonne gold (Minister of Mines Annual Report 1926, page A312).
leads.operators: Aquarius Resources Limited, Geiger, K. Warren

leads.name: CORMORANT
leads.drill: A sample from the surface assayed 2.06 grams per tonne gold, 6.86 grams per tonne silver and 2.7 per cent copper (Minister of Mines Annual Report 1913, page 285).

leads.name: SILVER BELL
leads.drill: A 10-centimetre wide channel sample assayed 3.3 grams per tonne gold, 98.8 grams per tonne silver 3.88 per cent lead and 3.95 per cent zinc (Geological Survey of Memoir 223, page 7).

leads.name: ROANAN
leads.drill: A sample across 1.83 metres in the surface exposure, taken in 1917, assayed 48.68 grams per tonne gold and 349.74 grams per tonne silver (United States Geological Survey, Bulletin 807). In the lower drift, the vein averages 30 centimetres in width and contains sparsely distributed grains of scheelite over a length of 15 metres with an estimated grade of 0.05 per cent scheelite (United States Geological Survey, Bulletin 1024-F).
